messages:
linda_sec: Alert: tenant 7832 reporting SCIM provisioning failures -> our service gets 401 from their OIDC token introspection. Started ~14:02 UTC.
tom_ops: seeing it too, correlation id scim-req-9a7f, stack shows 401 from https://idp.partner.example.com/introspect. Any recent changes on our side?
evan_dev: no deploys touching scim or auth in last 24h. Can you paste the raw introspect response?

nora_idp: pasted sample: ```{
  "active": false,
  "scope": "openid profile",
  "client_id": "svc-scim"
}```

linda_sec: our logic expects active=true and audience includes `redwood-scim`. Response missing aud and active=false -> we reject.
tom_ops: why would IdP return active=false for valid token? Check token issuer/aud mismatch or KMS envelope mismatch for client secrets.
evan_dev: good call. The token introspection requires a client assertion signed with tenant-specific KMS key alias `alias/ten-7832-client`. If that key rotated last night but we didn't update the secret, introspection fails or returns inactive.
kms-bot: key-rotate: alias/ten-7832-client rotated at 2026-03-18T03:12:00Z by ops. Previous key id: 1234abcd, current: 5678efgh.

nora_idp: the IdP requires the old kid for replay window of 2h; after that it marks assertions inactive. Did we rotate earlier than their expected window?
tom_ops: rotation was internal; we recompiled and used new kid immediately. If IdP still validates against the old kid in their cache, they might mark our assertion invalid.
evan_dev: mitigation options: 1) replay with re-encrypted assertion using old key (if still available in KMS history), 2) ask partner to accept new kid / refresh their JWKS, 3) fallback to a service account auth for provisioning while we sort keys.
linda_sec: short-term, enable service-account token fallback for tenant 7832 and open ticket to coordinate key sync. Also audit any provisioning gaps in last 6h.
tom_ops: enabling fallback now: scim.fallback_enabled=tenant:7832 by feature flag. Will route to svcacct token API.
kms-bot: key-forward: archived key 1234abcd available for decrypt in KMS-grave for 48h. Manual re-encrypt possible.
evan_dev: I'll prepare a repro: create client assertion signed with archived key and call introspect to confirm IdP behavior. Also add extra logging when introspect response missing aud.
ora_idp: partner confirmed they rotated JWKS refresh window later today but will accept a retry if we present assertion signed by current kid. They also asked for the pubkey thumbprint we used.
linda_sec: action items: Evan produce repro + patch to accept aud-less introspect only in fallback path (with strict audit), Tom keep fallback on until partner confirms, Nora coordinate pubkey thumbprint exchange and ask partner to refresh JWKS, Ops run runbook steps in SEC-RBAC-KEYSYNC.
tom_ops: audit query saved: `select ts, tenant, method, status from scim_introspect where tenant=7832 and ts >= '2026-03-18T00:00:00Z'` - pushing to ticket.
evan_dev: will also add a unit test: introspect response missing aud but active=true -> log and accept only in fallback.
linda_sec: recommend we update runbook to include KMS rotation handshake checklist: notify partner, ensure replay window, and test introspect after rotation. I'll draft the update.
ora_idp: partner says they'll hotfix JWKS cache refresh on their side and confirm when live.
tom_ops: fallback healthy, provisioning resumed for tenant 7832. Will watch for regressions.
linda_sec: thanks team. We'll keep the ticket open until partner confirms JWKS refresh and we revert fallback. :white_check_mark:
